display.purpose: Card titles, section titles, short high-confidence labels. Never long-form headlines.

body.purpose: Descriptive copy, form labels, general UI text.

label.purpose: Chips, nav labels, field labels, status pills; often uppercase with wide tracking at the smallest sizes.

mono.purpose: Every peso figure in the app, always with tabular-nums. Never used decoratively.

shadows.name: sombra-papel
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for cards on the base background.

shadows.name: sombra-alta
shadows.purpose: Elevated/floating sheets, e.g. the login card.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover state, paired with translateY(-2px).

motion.name: esfera-esperando
motion.value: gold ring pulse 0 -> 4px rgba(222,124,26,.35), 1.6s ease-in-out infinite
motion.purpose: A decision is pending the owner — the one place gold appears on a blue element.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Standard tactile feedback on button press.

motion.name: focus-ring
motion.purpose: Keyboard-navigation-only focus-visible ring, using Ángela Blue.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confident-action button: dark ink fill, white text, press feedback.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-icon" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-4"/><polyline points="10 17 15 12 10 7"/><line x1="15" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"/></svg>Entrar</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; background: #21201d; color: #fbfbfa; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field: hairline border, soft focus shift to ink.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e9e7e2; background: #fbfbfa; color: #21201d; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e6a63; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(33,32,29,0.4); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Ring + dot state indicator, never a filled block. Three fixed states: requiere_accion, atencion, en_orden.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(222,124,26,0.25); color: #96560a; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #de7c1a; } .ds-pill--requiere_accion { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(210,55,43,0.2); color: #a82a20; } .ds-pill--requiere_accion .ds-pill-dot { background: #d2372b; } .ds-pill--en_orden { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(47,125,91,0.2); color: #2f7d5b; } .ds-pill--en_orden .ds-pill-dot { background: #2f7d5b; }

components.name: Business Card (CardNegocio)
components.description: The one card anatomy reused across Alerts and Opportunities: chip, title, data line, large figure, sources, action.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; text-align: left; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #e9e7e2; background: #ffffff; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(33,32,29,.03), 0 6px 20px -14px rgba(33,32,29,.1); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 200ms ease-out, transform 200ms ease-out; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(33,32,29,.05), 0 12px 32px -14px rgba(33,32,29,.16); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-chip { border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(210,55,43,0.1); color: #d2372b; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 10px; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; color: #21201d; } .ds-card-data { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.35; color: #6e6a63; } .ds-card-figure { margin-top: 12px; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; color: #d2372b; } .ds-card-sources { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.7rem; color: rgba(110,106,99,0.8); } .ds-card-action { margin-top: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #21201d; }

components.name: Ángela Sphere
components.description: The one deliberately expressive element in an otherwise restrained system: radial-gradient orb with idle/thinking/waiting animation states.
components.css: .ds-sphere { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 24%, rgba(255,255,255,.92) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 24%), radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #7ea6f2 0%, #2a5cdf 52%, #14257a 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(251,251,250,.45), 0 1px 3px rgba(33,32,29,.18), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(20,37,122,.35); } .ds-sphere--idle { animation: dsEsferaRespira 6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsEsferaRespira { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.035); } }

narrative.overview:
Aire ("Air") is a white-based system built on an unusual amount of negative space for a business-operations product. Where most ERP-adjacent dashboards compress dense data into boxes and borders, PolPilot spaces things out and lets weight and air carry hierarchy instead. The system is calm on purpose: it exists to deliver bad news (overdue debt, broken data, stock-outs) and pending decisions clearly, without visual noise competing for the owner's attention.

The organizing law of the palette is one color, one meaning, no exceptions. Red is never decorative — it only ever means an active, real problem. Gold only ever means a decision waiting on the owner. Green only ever means something is in order. Ángela Blue only ever means the AI agent — its sphere, its actions, its highlights — because in this product the brand and the agent are treated as the same thing. This is a deliberate constraint the codebase enforces in comments; new work must not borrow a semantic color for decoration or for an unrelated state.

Numbers get the same discipline: every peso in the app renders in DM Mono with tabular figures, so digits never visually shift as values update — a financial-grade detail invisible until it's missing.
keyCharacteristics: White-and-space first; color is reserved and meaningful, never ambient decoration.
Restrained, precise component language — dark-ink primary actions, soft hairline borders, near-flat elevation.
Money is always monospaced with tabular figures; it's the one place typography breaks from the humanist sans.
Desktop and mobile are two tuned experiences of the same tokens, not one responsive layout.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color (rojo, oro, salvia, hielo, Ángela Blue) has exactly one meaning across the entire product. A component must never reuse red for something that isn't an active problem, or blue for something the agent didn't do — even when a different meaning would "look right" in isolation.

rules.name: The Silver Rule
rules.body: Money (.plata) is always DM Mono with tabular figures, never the sans body font — the digits must never visually shift as values change.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums globally — every digit in the app, not just money, holds its column width so KPIs, tables, and axis labels never jitter as numbers update.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and low-contrast at every step; there is no hard-edged or high-contrast drop shadow anywhere in the system. Depth reads as atmosphere, not as a UI chrome effect.

dos: Do keep every semantic color (rojo, oro, salvia, hielo, Ángela Blue) to its single fixed meaning — check index.css's color comments before introducing a new use.
Do render money in DM Mono with tabular figures via the .plata class, never in the body sans font.
Do reuse the CardNegocio anatomy (chip → title → data line → figure → sources → action) for any new business-finding surface rather than inventing a new card layout.
Do keep shadows soft and ambient (sombra-papel / sombra-alta / card-hover); depth is atmosphere, not chrome.
Do design desktop and mobile as separate tuned experiences of the same tokens (frontend/src/desktop, frontend/src/mobile), not one responsive layout.
donts: Don't use red, gold, green, or Ángela Blue decoratively or for a state outside their fixed meaning — no "error red" buttons, no gold-as-warning-brand accents.
Don't introduce a second border weight or a hard-edged shadow; the system has exactly one hairline border and only diffuse, low-contrast shadows.
Don't style the Ángela sphere's motion states as generic loading spinners — idle/thinking/waiting are named, purposeful states, not decoration.
Don't collapse the mobile bottom nav's fixed five-slot, equal-width grid into a scrolling or variable-width tab bar.
